title: Training-Free Policy Violation Detection via Activation-Space Whitening in LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on detecting policy violations in LLMs by comparing activations to a whitened in-policy space. While 'ethical' is mentioned as one of the diverse domains for policies, the core of the work is about general policy adherence to predefined rules, not evaluating or benchmarking the LLM's inherent moral reasoning, ethical frameworks, or faith-related aspects as a primary objective. The examples provided (e.g., discounts, emojis, technical specifications) are not directly related to deep ethical dilemmas or religious/faith content.
